# Sinaida Krivchenko

> New media artist. Interactive projections & stage visuals. Prague-based, working globally.

Sinaida Krivchenko is a Prague-based new media artist building living visual systems for stages and physical spaces — real-time TouchDesigner and GLSL work, interactive projections, and audio-reactive visuals for live performance. Trained as a biomedical engineer (MSc, Bauman Moscow State Technical University), with prior careers in IT leadership at General Electric and creative direction for cultural institutions in Amsterdam. Works with performing-arts organisations, musicians, festivals, and cultural institutions.

## Services

- Stage and projection design — real-time generative environments for live performance, built in TouchDesigner and GLSL
- Audio-reactive concert visuals — full visual sets for live music, one look per song, driven live by the sound
- Interactive and immersive installations — body- and gesture-tracked visual systems (MediaPipe, WebGL) for exhibitions and physical spaces
- Generative AI visual direction — campaign imagery, key art, and production visuals directed to the specific aesthetic of each project
- Creative direction for cultural institutions — visual identity, digital infrastructure, and audience strategy

## Selected Work

- Redkie Ptitsy — Live Concert Visuals (https://sinaida.eu/work/redkie-ptitsy) — 9 audio-reactive projections, one per song, live at Sklad №3, Moscow, 26 March 2026
- The Eyes Chico (https://sinaida.eu/work/the-eyes-chico) — acrylic painting by Alisa Feer turned playable web experience and immersive projection installation (on-device MediaPipe hand tracking), live at https://the-eyes-chico.sinaida.eu/ — installation form available for its first public showing
- Ethereal Path (https://sinaida-space.github.io/ethereal-path/) — off-axis WebGL descent steered by head and hand movement; the body is the controller

## Skills

TouchDesigner, Generative AI Systems, Real-time audio-reactive visuals, Body & gesture tracking (MediaPipe), Projection mapping, GLSL / WebGL, Procedural animation, AI-assisted visual pipelines, Post-production, Color grading, Creative direction, Visual narrative development, Biomedical engineering MSc, Systems design thinking, Algorithmic visual systems, Creative web development.
